name: slg-website

scripts.build:standalone: next build && rm -rf .next/standalone/.next/static .next/standalone/public && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -R public .next/standalone/public
scripts.check:content: npm run check:types && npm run check:frontmatter && npm run check:pairs && npm run check:nomenclature && npm run check:pending
scripts.test:db: npm run test:isolation && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:nocompile
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:setup-role
scripts.test:ci-gates: node scripts/ci/test-secret-scanner.ts && node scripts/ci/test-lighthouse-gate.ts && node scripts/content/verify-gates.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check:secrets && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && npm run check:content && npm run test:ci-gates && npm run build:standalone && npm run check:lighthouse

description: Website pública, HQ y portal de clientes de SLG Agency
